newsitem.title: MEXICO: Hurricane Fausto threatens Mexico's Baja California.
newsitem.headline: Hurricane Fausto threatens Mexico's Baja California.

text.p: Hurricane Fausto, packing winds of up to 115 mph (185 kph), was threatening the southern end of Mexico's Baja California peninsula in the Pacific Ocean, Mexican officials said on Thursday.
The hurricane was 65 miles (105 km) south-southwest of the popular resort Cabo San Lucas at the tip of the peninsula, the National Meteorological Service said in a report.

"In the the past three hours it has remained nearly parked, but nonetheless the centre of Hurricane Fausto has initiated a change in direction, tending to move toward the north," said the service's report at 10 p.m. EDT (0200 GMT).
Southern Baja California and areas along the nearby Mexican mainland have been placed under alert.
